Problem Statement:
Delete the elements in a linked list whose sum is equal to zero and print the resulting linked list. 
Input Description:
First line represents the size of the linked list.Next line represents the sequence of numbers as the node value of the linked list(separated by space). 
Output Description:
Print the resultant linked list values(separated by space). 
Sample Input:
8
6 -6 8 4 -12 9 8 -8 
Sample Output:
9 
Explanation:
Remove the nodes whose sum is equal to zero and return the root of the linked list.
